newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent ends down on API expectations.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent ends down on API expectations.

text.p: IPE Brent crude futures ended lower, wiping out mild gains earlier in the session as traders anticipated further pressure on heating oil markets in the U.S. and Europe.
December Brent ended down ten cents at $22.18 a barrel, near the bottom of the day's range and off a high of $22.50.

Dealers said expectations of a further recovery in U.S. heating oil stocks on the release later on Tuesday of American Petroleum Inventory statistics undermined crude prices toward the close of the session.
"The APIs should show another build in heating oil and that's outweighing other factors in the market," said an IPE broker.
Traders surveyed by Reuters were expecting about a 2.5 million barrel distillates build on top of last week's 3.6 million barrel rise.
U.S. refiners have been pumping record distillates volumes in recent weeks.
IPE gas oil futures also ended lower, down 50 cents at $208.75 but reversed bigger losses in a late bout of spread buying.
European gas oil traders said an incoming fleet of diesel cargoes from Algeria and the U.S. was pressuring northwest European physical markets.
Earlier concerns over seven hours of surgery on Russian President Boris Yeltsin melted away after the operation was declared a success.
